[[Vanquisher|Vanquish]] [[Kessex Peak]].

== Quest information ==
=== Objectives ===
* Clear Kessex Peak in [[Kryta]] of all enemies in [[hard mode]].
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

=== Reward ===
* 10,000 [[Experience]]
* 1,500 [[Gold]]
* Complete the Base Objective for 150 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].

== Dialogues ==
=== Initial dialogue ===
; [[Zaishen Vanquish]]
: ''"Clear Kessex Peak in Kryta of all enemies in hard mode."''
{{offer dialogue
|accept = I can do that!
|decline = No, I'm way too busy today.
|ask = There are still threats that remain. Return when you have slain all of the foes that await you at your destination.}}

=== Reward dialogue ===
; Zehnchu
: ''"Excellent work! The Zaishen admire your dedication."''

== Notes ==
* This area is harder if [[War in Kryta]] is active.
* Consider completing this quest at the same time as the [[Verata (Zaishen quest)|Verata]], [[Wanted: Destor the Truth Seeker|Destor the Truth Seeker]], [[Wanted: Justiciar Amilyn|Justiciar Amilyn]], and/or [[Wanted: Justiciar Marron|Justiciar Marron]] bounties.
